title: Kit's BaseMods
description: A bunch of mods i use as a base for all my modpacks
body:
A bunch of fun, easy to start a modpack on a server:
-More recepies and ways to cook
-New biomes
-New ores
-More Rpg feeling
-Diferent mobs
-Better ai on the mobs
-Machines for automatitation 
-Backpack
-Gliders
-Furniture
-Voice Chat
-Veiner
-Dynamic Lights
-Lootr
-Sound control
To play alone or with friends, Can be used in lan or adding it to a server, if any error just contact me!
